name: Object Detection
learningObjectives: Understand the fundamentals of object detection in images
Learn how sliding window approaches work for object localization
Understand bounding box prediction and confidence scores
Learn about Intersection over Union (IoU) metrics
Apply Non-Maximum Suppression to remove duplicate detections
Visualize detection results with bounding boxes

controls.name: windowSize
controls.label: Window Size
controls.description: Size of the sliding window for object detection

controls.name: stride
controls.label: Stride
controls.description: Step size for sliding the detection window

controls.name: confidenceThreshold
controls.label: Confidence Threshold
controls.description: Minimum confidence score to consider a detection valid

controls.name: learningRate
controls.label: Learning Rate
controls.description: Step size for gradient descent updates

datasets.name: Multiple Objects (16x16)
datasets.description: Images with multiple objects to detect

visualizations.name: Detection Results
visualizations.description: Detected objects with bounding boxes overlaid on the image

metrics.name: Precision
metrics.description: Proportion of detected objects that are correct

metrics.name: Recall
metrics.description: Proportion of actual objects that were detected

metrics.name: F1 Score
metrics.description: Harmonic mean of precision and recall

metrics.name: Avg Detections/Image
metrics.description: Average number of objects detected per image
